description: This file contains functions to render an ellipsoid in OpenGL using specified detail levels and color. It provides rendering for faces and edges of the ellipsoid as well as drawing diagonal lines for wireframe purposes.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipsoid_faces(lua_Number radius,lua_Integer detail_x,lua_Integer detail_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the filled faces of an ellipsoid with specified radius, detail, and color.

methods.name: void lu5_render_ellipsoid_edges(lua_Number radius,lua_Integer detail_x,lua_Integer detail_y,lu5_color color)
methods.description: Renders the wireframe edges (vertical, horizontal, and diagonal lines) of an ellipsoid with specified parameters.
